what_this_is: The APPROVED public Overpass API endpoints the discovery factory may query, in preference order. PTF-DISCOVERY-OVERPASS-RESILIENCE-001: one public endpoint timing out at the TCP layer stalled a whole market for hours with nothing else wrong. Rotation here exists to survive an endpoint OUTAGE, never to evade a provider's rate limit: an endpoint that rate-limits or refuses us goes into cooldown, and the client keeps concurrency at 1 with spacing between queries on every endpoint.
provenance: Public instances listed at https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API#Public_Overpass_API_instances (read 2026-08-25). Fair-use guidance for the main instance: https://dev.overpass-api.de/overpass-doc/en/preface/commons.html

endpoints.notes: The main public instance; the endpoint every prior market was censused from. Fair use: under 10,000 queries and 1 GB per day, unique User-Agent.
Kumi Systems public instance; global data; listed on the OSM wiki as a public mirror that accepts the same fair-use client behaviour.
Private.coffee public instance; global data; listed on the OSM wiki. Third in order so the two longer-established instances are asked first.
Swiss instance with SWITZERLAND-ONLY data. Disabled: it would return zero elements for every US cell and a zero-element response is indistinguishable from an empty cell.
VK Maps public instance; global data. Disabled until an operator verifies its terms of use for automated research clients; enabling it is a registry edit, not a code change.
